The boy, who appeared stable after the rescue, was immediately taken to a hospital for examination.
title: 4-year-old pulled out safely from borewell after 9-hour rescue operation in Punjab

author: TOI Education
description: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has announced a re-examination for NEET UG 2026 on June 21, 2026, following directions from the National Medical Commission. Candidates can update their present address and exam city preferences from May 15 to May 21, 2026. The exam will be conducted offline in 13 languages.
title: NEET UG 2026 re-exam: NTA opens correction window to modify address, select cities

author: HINDOL BASU
description: Shreyas Iyer's stellar IPL-2026 campaign, marked by consistent middle-order batting and composed chases, has positioned him for a potential return to the Indian T20I squad. Despite Punjab Kings' recent struggles, Iyer's individual performance, including five half-centuries, highlights his evolution as a reliable finisher and leader.
title: In-form Shreyas Iyer's numbers stand tall, but will they carry Punjab Kings into playoffs?

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Indian consumers may soon face higher prices as wholesale inflation surges, driven by global conflicts impacting commodity and energy costs. While retail inflation remains soft for now, a widening gap between wholesale and consumer price indices suggests businesses will likely pass on increased production expenses, leading to costlier everyday goods and services in the coming months.
title: Wholesale prices are up — your bills could be next, Crisil warns

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in the Netherlands for the second leg of his five-nation tour, aiming to deepen bilateral ties. He will hold talks with Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten, call on King Willem-Alexander and Queen Maxima, and address the Indian community.
title: From semiconductors to water - what’s on PM Modi’s Netherlands agenda

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: After a stuttering start to IPL 2026, Gujarat Titans have emerged as one of the tournament’s most complete sides, with a relentless bowling attack led by Kagiso Rabada, Mohammed Siraj, Prasidh Krishna. Speaking to the Teamofindia.com, Prasidh opens up on GT’s turnaround, the team’s hard-length bowling philosophy, Shubman Gill’s calm leadership and his own evolution after last season’s Purple Cap-winning campaign.
title: Rabada, Siraj and hard lengths: The bowling identity driving Gujarat Titans

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Taiwan's defense ministry reported eight Chinese naval vessels near the island following US President Trump's China visit. Trump suggested China might act against Taiwan after his term, acknowledging Beijing's strong objections to its independence. The US arms package for Taiwan remains under review amid escalating tensions and China's territorial claims.
title: After Trump’s Beijing visit, Taiwan detects Chinese naval vessels near its waters

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee faces an FIR for alleged inflammatory statements, including remarks on DJs and Union Home Minister Amit Shah. He accused the Centre of allowing post-poll violence in West Bengal and manipulating the election counting process, with party candidates and agents allegedly removed from centers.
title: FIR against Abhishek Banerjee over inflammatory statements, remarks against Amit Shah

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A retired district judge and her advocate son were booked in Bhopal for the alleged dowry death of the latter's wife, Twisha Sharma. Sharma was found hanging at her marital home, with her family alleging dowry harassment and murder. The retired judge has since been granted anticipatory bail.
title: ‘Multiple antemortem injuries’: Chilling details emerge in Noida dowry death case

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Despite a victory over Chennai Super Kings, Lucknow Super Giants captain Rishabh Pant expressed dejection over the team's disappointing IPL 2026 season. LSG, already eliminated, secured a seven-wicket win powered by Mitchell Marsh and Nicholas Pooran, but Pant highlighted frustrations with implementing the team's thought process effectively.
title: 'The only thing can harm us ... ': Rishabh Pant opens up

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Trump declared his China visit a historic "G-2" success, highlighting major trade deals including Boeing aircraft sales and agricultural commitments. He also suggested China would refrain from aggressive action on Taiwan during his presidency, while Xi Jinping privately warned of confrontation over the island. Trump indicated China's willingness to help broker an end to the Iran conflict.
title: '2 great countries': Trump hails meeting with Xi as 'G-2 moment'

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Gig workers are staging a temporary nationwide strike, halting app-based services from 12 pm to 5 pm on Saturday. This protest, organized by GIPSWU, targets rising fuel prices and inadequate payment rates, which are significantly impacting drivers' daily earnings. The union aims to highlight the financial strain caused by increased fuel costs and low payouts.
title: Petrol, diesel price hike: App based gig workers call for nationwide strike

description: Suriya's 'Karuppu' has made a powerful debut at the box office, raking in ₹20.66 crore worldwide on its opening day. description: Jasprit Bumrah captained Mumbai Indians for the first time in IPL 2026, leading them to a win against Punjab Kings. Drawing a parallel to the film 'Nayak', Bumrah expressed his enjoyment of the role. This experience adds to his prior captaincy stints with the Indian national team in Tests and T20Is.
title: 'Ek din ka mukhya mantri': Jasprit Bumrah reacts after MI captaincy debut

description: With playoffs in sight, Gujarat Titans and Royal Challengers Bangalore are strong contenders, boasting high qualification probabilities. Sunrisers Hyderabad also hold a solid chance. author: SOUMITRA BOSE
description: A 35-year-old shoe seller from Solapur, living in Pune, was arrested at Nagpur railway station for allegedly planting a low-intensity bomb at a Pune hospital. Shivaji Rathod, unable to afford treatment for a sexually transmitted disease, attempted to extort money by creating panic. He was apprehended by the ATS on a train after a manhunt.
title: Pune hospital bomb scare: Shoe seller held from train for planting IED to extort money

author: ANJANAYA SINGH
description: Lucknow University's zoology assistant professor is in police custody following allegations of leaking exam papers and making inappropriate advances towards a female student. Audio recordings, submitted by the student, reportedly capture the professor discussing paper leaks and offering academic favours in exchange for meetings. The university initiated an internal probe before police registered an FIR.
title: 'Calling to molest again': Lucknow professor offers to leak exam paper to girl student

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Taylor Swift fans sparked fresh online drama after old Joe Alwyn headlines resurfaced on X. One viral fan comment claimed Alwyn “wouldn't have a dollar” without Swift’s support, triggering heated debate across social media. While some users defended the actor, many Swifties mocked his career struggles. The controversy comes as attention around Swift’s future with Travis Kelce and growing wedding rumours continues dominating entertainment headlines throughout 2026.
title: 'Talentless loser': Taylor Swift fans slam Joe Alwyn amid Kelce wedding buzz

author: TNN
description: The Supreme Court has given Kannada actor Darshan a year to approach for bail if his trial in the Renukaswamy murder case shows no substantial progress. The court directed the Karnataka government to ensure 60 witnesses are examined within this period, urging the trial court to avoid adjournments on flimsy grounds.
title: No bail relief for Darshan, SC asks Karnataka to examine 60 key witnesses in 1 year

title: Afridi clashes with Pakistan captain in dressing room after shock Bangladesh defeat
